title: Do Not Stomp the Mushrooms
story: Deep in the Glowspore Caverns, Sporegorge the Puffcap Fiend giggles from a ring of 7 fat blue mushrooms. 'Stomp me!' it dares. 'Everyone stomps!' Mr 6 remembers the miners' warning: every single stomp makes every mushroom split into two, and he decides to count before he kicks.
question: If Mr 6 stomped 5 times in a row, and all 7 mushrooms doubled with each stomp, how many mushrooms would be standing after the fifth stomp?
hint: Doubling five times means multiplying by 2 five separate times — try writing 7, then 14, and keep going.
victory: 'Two hundred twenty-four? No thank you,' said Mr 6, and he simply picked the seven mushrooms and put them in a basket. Sporegorge, with nothing left to split, popped into a puff of harmless blue glitter.
imagePrompt: A small numeral-six knight standing thoughtfully with sword lowered before a ring of glowing blue mushrooms and a grinning spore fiend in a softly luminous underground cavern.
solution: Doubling five times means multiplying by 2 five times: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 32.
After the fifth stomp there are 224 mushrooms.
praise: You spotted that the mushrooms keep doubling - the trick is doubling five separate times, not just multiplying by 5.
